marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 20 knots diminishing to light Friday morning then
increasing to south 20 early Friday evening. Scattered showers changing to periods of drizzle Friday
morning then to rain Friday evening. Fog patches forming Friday
morning. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 to 2 metres subsiding to 1 or less near noon
Friday.<br/>
